places-la-saltadora-abric-xii-abrigo-del.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-la-saltadora-abric-xii-abrigo-del.story: From Albocàsser it runs 186 km to Albocàsser; allow about 3 h 12 of riding. On the way it passes Cova Remigia- Abric l, Barranco de Gibert II, Abrigo del Arenal de la fonseca ó Abrigo d and back through Barranco de Gibert II. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
